events.verdict: Risacher (ATL) is retreating his arm into a vertical position and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs with Siakam's (IND) left arm after his gather.
Hunter (ATL) makes clean contact with the ball as he reaches in and dislodges it away from Turner (IND) prior to incidental contact occurring when they come together in the lane.

Instant replay is triggered to review if Risacher (ATL) does not release the ball prior to the expiration of the shot clock. After communicating with the Replay Center, the call on the floor is confirmed. Atlanta commits a 24-second shot clock violation.
Risacher (ATL) fails to fully clear the lane and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds involving Nembhard (IND) and Young (ATL) called as a jump ball pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Young gets his hand to the ball to dislodge it before incidental contact occurs with Nembhard, who is also the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds. ATL is correctly awarded possession.
Hunter (ATL) rests his hands on Siakam (IND) as they briefly engage and separate during the inbound.
Daniels (ATL) commits a take foul on Haliburton (IND).
Daniels (ATL) commits a take foul on Nesmith (IND).
There is no clear and conclusive video evidence to overturn the call on the floor of Turner (IND) dislodging the ball out of bounds.
Mathews (ATL) commits a take foul on Sheppard (IND).
